item.description: Tillamook sales jumped nearly 250 percent in about a decade, to more than $1.2 billion. And the company still belongs to Oregon dairy farm families, not outside shareholders. It started in 1909, when 10 small dairies each put in $10 to make cheese they could stand behind. More than a century later, that same cooperative still owns the company. That is rare in our grocery aisles. So many familiar brands get bought, merged, and handed to investors who never had to worry about a herd, a harvest, or a small town. Tillamook puts it simply: it has stakeholders, not shareholders. Farmers still own it and lead it, and that long view shows. Growth did not have to mean selling out. Sometimes it can mean a group of families built something good, kept it, and let more of us enjoy it...

item.title: GovBrief Today #662
item.description: Donald Trump told Nvidia's board that Jensen Huang poses no threat to national security, and the board made Huang chief executive again. Nvidia makes most of the chips that run artificial intelligence, and the United States limits their sale to China for national security reasons. Huang resigned 11 days ago over affairs with an executive who reported to him and a woman US intelligence believes spies for China. Last week the board's chair said Nvidia would not rehire him because his behavior did not fit the company's code of conduct. Then Vice President JD Vance and other officials spent the weekend leaning on the directors, Trump called them himself, and the board caved. "I made the deal," Trump said. Trump was first warned about the woman a year ago and again in May. He owns millions of dollars in Nvidia stock, and last December he and Huang struck a deal giving the government 25% of Nvidia's chip sales to China. Tonight on Fox, his attorney general would not say whether Huang had been cleared. On February 1, 2025, I typed a list of nine things I never imagined a government doing in one day and sent it to my family. I've sent one every night since: 10,073 stories over 662 straight nights, free and without ads. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I'll send it to you too.
